name: Shigeru
source:
Minoru's younger brother. He currently studying at a high school on the mainland. He is incredibly popular with girls but rejects their advances. 

This is causing him stress because rumors are circulating of him being a homosexual. In reality, he wishes to find a whore like his sister in laws to proudly introduce to the family.
